I loose the Bronze Fury. Vermithor descends upon Oldtown, and the Starry Sept - the oldest and holiest seat of the Faith in all Westeros, where the Andal kings were blessed a thousand years before my house was born - is drowned in dragonfire. Its crystal dome shatters like an eggshell; the High Septon and the Most Devout burn to ash within.

The realm recoils in horror. From the Reach to the Vale to the stony Vale of Arryn, the pious lords take up the old cry of the Faith Militant: the dragon king is a monster, and must be pulled down as his uncle nearly was. I have made war upon the Seven, and the Seven have answered with the wrath of half my kingdom.

#bold Fire and blood. The whole realm may come, if it dares. #!
russian: Вермитор спускается на Старый город. Звёздная Септа горит — её купол разбит, Верховный Септон и Наиболее Благочестивые сгорели внутри.\n\nКоролевство в ужасе. Благочестивые лорды поднимают клич Воинства Веры: король-дракон — чудовище. Я начал войну против Семерых, и они ответили гневом половины моего королевства. Пусть приходят.

english:
I will not burn them as my uncle would have. Instead I demand the oldest and most sacred of the Faith's own judgments: a #bold Trial of Seven#!. Seven champions shall fight for the Crown, and seven for the Faith, and the gods themselves will declare, through blood and steel, who is righteous.

The High Septon is too frail to lift a sword, so the Faith turns to its mightiest son: the #bold Lord of Oldtown#! himself shall champion the Seven, and the knights of the Hightower shall fill out his seven. And I shall fight in my own name - for the gods' verdict is not a thing a king may delegate. Each of us must now gather our champions, the finest swords who will stand with us in the yard before the Starry Sept.

If my seven prevail, then the gods have spoken: the Doctrine of Exceptionalism is proven true, and the Faith must bow to the verdict of its own holy trial. But if we fall, then I am judged a sinner before gods and men - and there is no appeal from such a judgment, nor will I survive it. The septons pray. The gods are watching.

#bold For the dragon, and for the truth. The champions will be gathered. #!
russian: Я не сожгу их. Вместо этого я требую Суда Семерых: семь чемпионов Короны против семи чемпионов Веры, и пусть боги объявят через кровь и сталь, кто праведен.\n\nЛорд Старого города будет чемпионом Семерых. Я буду сражаться в своём имени — приговор богов нельзя делегировать. Если мои семеро победят — Доктрина доказана. Если падём — я осуждён, и нет апелляции. Септоны молятся. Боги смотрят.

english:
The last of my champions falls in the bloodied mud before the sept, and the septons raise their voices to the heavens in triumph. The gods have spoken - and their verdict is against me. I staked my marriage on their judgment before ten thousand witnesses, and there is no appeal from a Trial of Seven: to defy it now would be to hand the Faith Militant half my realm.

So the price is paid, and it is crueler than any sword. The High Septon declares my marriage to Alysanne dissolved in the eyes of gods and men, sinful and void from its first hour - and any children born of it are named abominations, unfit to ever sit the Iron Throne. And for Alysanne herself, the Faith claims its most terrible mercy: the grey robes of the #bold Silent Sisters#!, that she might atone for our sin in service to the Stranger, wordless until her dying day.

The sisters come for her at dusk. She does not weep where they can see her; that mercy she leaves for me alone. At the door she turns - and says nothing, for she has already begun her silence. But her eyes say what her tongue may never speak again: #italic it was never sin.#!

#bold I have lost her - to the gods who judged us, and the silence they demand. #!
russian: Последний из моих чемпионов пал. Боги заговорили против меня. Нет апелляции от Суда Семерых.\n\nВерховный Септон объявляет мой брак расторгнутым, греховным с самого начала. Алисанна отдана Молчаливым Сёстрам — серые одежды, вечное молчание. У двери она оборачивается и ничего не говорит. Её глаза говорят: это никогда не было грехом.

english:
It is over. The last of the Faith's champions lies broken in the red mud before the Starry Sept, and a terrible hush falls over Oldtown. Seven fought for the Seven, and seven fought for the dragon - and the gods have rendered their verdict in blood and steel, as the Faith's own holiest law demands.

The septons stare at the carnage, ashen-faced. There is no appeal from a Trial of Seven; the judgment is holy, and final, and it is #bold mine#!. The Doctrine of Exceptionalism is no longer the plea of a king - it is the proven will of the gods, declared before ten thousand witnesses in the shadow of the Faith's own great sept.

The Most Devout may write it into their holy books, for the gods themselves have written it first, in blood.

#bold The gods are with the dragon. The Faith will bow. #!
russian: Последний чемпион Веры лежит в красной грязи перед Звёздной Септой. Семеро сражались за Семерых, семеро за дракона — и боги вынесли вердикт.\n\nНет апелляции от Суда Семерых. Приговор свят и окончателен — и он мой. Доктрина Исключительности — доказанная воля богов, объявленная перед десятью тысячами свидетелей. Пусть Вера запишет это в свои книги.

english:
Beneath the crystal dome of the Starry Sept, the High Septon lifts his voice before the assembled Most Devout and proclaims the Doctrine of Exceptionalism an official tenet of the Faith of the Seven. His voice does not waver, though every soul beneath the dome knows why he speaks: the Faith called upon the gods to judge the dragon, and the gods answered - for the dragon.

I did not burn them, as my uncle would have. I did not beg them, as they expected. I gave the Seven their own holiest trial and let their own gods speak - and now no septon may name my marriage sin, nor my children abominations, without calling the gods themselves liars. The verdict was written in blood before ten thousand witnesses, and it shall be written in the holy books for all the ages to come.

#bold The gods have judged, and the Faith must bow. The dragon and the Seven are reconciled - on the dragon's terms. #!
russian: Под куполом Звёздной Септы Верховный Септон провозглашает Доктрину догматом. Его голос не дрожит — все знают, почему он говорит: Вера призвала богов судить дракона, и боги ответили за дракона.\n\nЯ не сжёг их и не умолял. Я дал Семерым их собственный святой суд, и теперь ни один септон не может назвать мой брак грехом, не назвав богов лжецами. Вердикт написан кровью перед десятью тысячами свидетелей. Дракон и Вера примирены — на условиях дракона.

english:
It ends not with blood, but with silence. The appointed day comes, and the Crown's seven stand armed and ready in the yard before the Starry Sept - and across from them, no one. The Faith, for all its thundering, could not find seven champions willing to stake their lives on its accusation. By the Faith's own holiest law, an accusation that cannot be championed is no accusation at all: the gods find for the accused.

The High Septon has no choice. Beneath the crystal dome, before the assembled Most Devout, he proclaims the Doctrine of Exceptionalism a tenet of the Faith of the Seven. No septon may now name my marriage sin, nor my children abominations - for when the gods were asked to judge the dragon, not one man of the Faith dared carry their sword.

#bold The Seven were called to battle, and none came. The doctrine stands, now and forever. #!
russian: День суда настал, и семеро Короны стоят вооружённые — а напротив никого. Вера не нашла чемпионов. По закону Веры, обвинение без чемпионов — не обвинение.\n\nВерховный Септон провозглашает Доктрину догматом. Ни один септон не назовёт мой брак грехом — ибо когда богов попросили судить дракона, никто не осмелился нести их меч. Доктрина стоит навеки.

english:
Enough of this. Why should the blood of Old Valyria - who ride dragons, who rule the greatest realm the world has known - bow and scrape before the pale gods of the Andals, who came crawling to Westeros long after my forefathers ruled the skies?

The dragonlords of the Freehold worshipped the fourteen flames and the fire made flesh, and asked no septon's leave to wed as they pleased. So shall we. I proclaim before the court that House Targaryen forsakes the Faith of the Seven and returns to the old gods of Valyria. The septons may wail and the smallfolk gape. We are dragons; we shall make our own gods, as we always have.

#bold We are the blood of the dragon. We will worship as Valyria did. #!
russian: Довольно. Почему кровь Валирии, оседлавшая драконов и правящая величайшим королевством, должна пресмыкаться перед богами андалов?\n\nДраконовладыки поклонялись Четырнадцати Огням и не спрашивали септона, на ком жениться. Я провозглашаю: дом Таргариенов отрекается от Веры Семерых и возвращается к старым богам Валирии. Пусть септоны воют. Мы драконы — мы создаём своих богов.

english:
The ravens fly, and every one carries the same word: war. The Lord of the Reach - in whose lands the Starry Sept lies in ashes and whose smallfolk sifted the bones of the High Septon from the ruin - has declared for the Faith, and the realm rises with him. The Riverlands. The Vale. The Westerlands. And the North - the Starks keep the old gods and care nothing for the Seven, but the burning of holy men alive in their own temple is a crime no honourable northman will suffer: they march not for the Faith, but against me.

Only the ironborn sit apart, praying to their drowned god and caring nothing for burned septs. The Crownlands stand by their king, and the Stormlands, who remember whose sword set me on this throne. Two kingdoms against five, and every sept in Westeros preaching holy war against the dragon who burned the gods' own house. My uncle faced the Faith Militant; I have made the whole realm my Faith Militant.

So be it. They wanted a monster on the Iron Throne. They will come and find one.

#bold Two kingdoms, two dragons, and fire and blood. The realm may come. #!
russian: Вороны несут весть о войне. Простор, Речные земли, Долина, Западные земли и даже Север выступают против меня. Только Коронные земли и Штормовые земли стоят за меня. Пять королевств против двух.\n\nМой дядя столкнулся с Воинством Веры; я сделал всё королевство моим врагом. Да будет так. Они хотели чудовище на троне — пусть найдут его.

english:
It is finished. Against five kingdoms and every sept in Westeros, the dragon has won. The hosts of the Faith lie broken from the Mander to the Trident; the lords who rose against me kneel in the ashes of their own fields, one by one, and press their lips to my ring while their eyes burn with hate.

My uncle told me once, in his way: the dragon rules, and the sheep obey. I did not wish to be my uncle - but they would not let me be anything else. The realm will remember what it cost to rise against Vermithor, and the memory will keep the peace better than love ever did.

There remains only one thing to take from them: the word they denied me, spoken from the ruin of their holiest place.

#bold The realm is broken to the saddle. Now the Faith will say the words. #!
russian: Всё кончено. Пять королевств разбиты. Лорды преклоняют колени в пепле своих полей, ненависть в глазах.\n\nПусть ненавидят. Мейгор однажды сказал: дракон правит, овцы повинуются. Я не хотел быть им — но они не позволили мне быть кем-то ещё. Королевство запомнит цену восстания, и память сохранит мир.

english:
They crown a new High Septon in a borrowed sept, for the old one is ash - and his first act, before septons whose hands shake as they hold the crystal, is to proclaim the Doctrine of Exceptionalism a holy tenet of the Faith of the Seven. His voice breaks as he says the words. No one beneath that roof believes them. Every one of them will repeat them until the day they die.

The Targaryens are exceptional. The Targaryens are not to be judged as common men. The Targaryens may wed as the dragonlords of old. So says the Faith - because the alternative is the fire.

My grandsire won his crown with dragons and kept it with mercy. My uncle had the dragons and not the mercy. And I? I offered the realm wisdom, and it chose to teach me that only the fire is ever truly heard.

#bold The doctrine stands - written not in ink, nor in blood, but in fire. #!
russian: Нового Верховного Септона коронуют в заимствованной септе — старая — пепел. Его первый акт — провозгласить Доктрину догматом. Голос срывается. Никто не верит, но все повторяют.\n\nТаргариены исключительны. Так говорит Вера — потому что альтернатива — огонь. Мой дед завоевал корону милостью, дядя имел драконов без милости. Я предложил мудрость — и узнал, что только огонь всегда слышат.

english:
The realm has won. Five kingdoms broke my hosts, my banners burned from the Mander to the kingsroad, and the men who marched beneath the seven-pointed star now dictate their peace beneath my own roof. They leave me my throne - a king they can point to, chastened, is worth more to them than a martyr - but they take everything else.

The marriage is declared an abomination, dissolved in the sight of gods and men. My children are named unfit to inherit, their blood tainted by sin. And Alysanne - Alysanne is given to the Silent Sisters, to atone in grey wordlessness for the crime of loving me. The sisters come for her while the septons watch, so that none may say the dragon hid his sin away.

She does not weep where they can see her. At the door she turns and says nothing, for her silence has already begun - but her eyes say what her tongue may never speak again: #italic it was never sin.#!

I burned the Starry Sept, and the realm burned my whole world in answer.

#bold The dragon reigns still - over the ashes of everything he loved. #!
russian: Королевство победило. Пять королевств разбили мои войска, и люди под семиконечной звездой диктуют мир. Они оставляют мне трон, но забирают всё остальное.\n\nБрак объявлен мерзостью, дети — недостойными. Алисанна отдана Молчаливым Сёстрам. У двери она оборачивается и ничего не говорит — но её глаза говорят: это никогда не было грехом. Я сжёг Звёздную Септу, и королевство сожгло весь мой мир.

english:
It is finished. Where once the Sept of Remembrance stood in ashes upon Rhaenys's Hill, there now rises the mightiest structure in all King's Landing - the Dragonpit, a vast dome of stone and iron seven acres wide, its bronze doors tall enough to admit a dragon in full flight. Years of labour and a king's fortune in gold have gone into its making, and now the great beasts of my house have a hall worthy of them.

From the walls of the Red Keep I can see it crowning the city, and the smallfolk gather in their thousands to marvel. All the world will see the power and the glory of House Targaryen made manifest in stone. A thing so grand should not pass unmarked - the realm shall have a grand tournament to celebrate it, the like of which has not been seen since my grandsire's day.

#bold The dragons have their pit. Now let the lords come and break their lances in its shadow. #!
russian: На холме Рейнис вырос величайший купол Королевской Гавани — Драконья яма. Бронзовые двери пропускают дракона в полёте, а семь акров камня и железа стали домом для моих зверей.\n\nСо стен Красного замка я вижу, как город дивится этому чуду. Столь великое дело заслуживает турнира — или скромного празднования. Пусть мир увидит могущество дома Таргариенов.

english:
Lord Manfryd Redwyne, my master of ships, has proved as deft with celebration as with fleets. At his urging, the completion of the Dragonpit is to be marked with a tourney fit for the wonder it honors.

The lists rise beneath the great dome itself. No dragon has yet settled in the pit, and so the vast hollow of stone and bronze becomes a field of banners, galleries, sand, barriers, and shouting men. Lords arrive with their retinues, freeriders with polished hopes, and hedge knights with armor beaten bright for one more chance at glory.

I take my place above the field with Alysanne beside me. Others may break lances and bones. A king need only watch, judge, and remember who shines when all the realm is looking.

#bold The Dragonpit is open. The tournament begins. #!
russian: Мастер над кораблями устроил турнир под куполом. Драконья яма ещё пуста, и её каменная полость стала полем для рыцарей, галерей и песка.\n\nЛорды и странствующие рыцари съехались со всего королевства. Я сижу над полем рядом с Алисанной, чтобы смотреть, судить и запоминать. Пусть турнир начнётся.

english:
The squires ride first, all long limbs, borrowed armor, and fierce young pride. More than one boy forgets his reins when the crowd roars; more than one learns, flat on his back in the sand, that glory has a hard edge.

Rickard Redwyne does not forget. He rides as if the din of the Dragonpit is only wind, taking each tilt cleanly, lowering his lance at the proper breath, and sending better-born boys tumbling before him. By the final pass even the hardened knights are nodding to one another.

When he kneels before me, dusty, flushed, and trying not to grin, I draw steel and touch it to his shoulders. The dome carries my words until every gallery hears them.

#bold Rise, Ser Rickard Redwyne. You have earned your spurs. #!
russian: Оруженосцы едут первыми — юные, горячие, в заёмных доспехах. Многие падают, но Рикард Редвин едет безупречно, сбивая родовитых соперников одного за другим.\n\nВ последнем проходе он преклоняет колено передо мной, и я касаюсь его плеч сталью. Весь купол слышит: «Встань, сир Рикард Редвин. Ты заслужил свои шпоры».

english:
The joust belongs to Ser Simon Dondarrion of Blackhaven.

Ser Robert Redwyne gives him a splendid contest, and others make him work harder still, but Simon only grows brighter with each broken lance. He smiles for the smallfolk, bows to the ladies, and rides like a song made flesh. By the final tilt the commons are chanting his name, and Alysanne herself is laughing behind her hand.

Then comes the choice all champions must make. Simon takes the wreath of flowers, turns beneath the thunder of the dome, and lays it before the young princess in the royal gallery.

#bold The Dragonpit shakes with cheers. Even Alysanne is won. #!
russian: Турнир принадлежит сиру Саймону Дондарриону. Он ломал копья лучше всех, улыбался толпе, и простой народ скандировал его имя.\n\nЗатем он взял венок и, к громовым аплодисментам, положил его перед молодой принцессой в королевской галерее. Даже Алисанна была покорена.

english:
The grand melee is too large for any field in the city, and so the empty Dragonpit receives it.

Seventy-seven knights are divided into eleven teams. They begin mounted, circling beneath the dome in colors bright as dragonfire, then crash together with a sound like a gatehouse falling. Men go down. Horses scream. Blunted weapons rise and fall, and those unhorsed fight on afoot until one team remains.

Alysanne forbids Jonquil Darke and Tom the Strummer from joining them, though neither takes the command kindly. I cannot fault her. This is sport only by courtesy. From the royal gallery it looks very much like war.

#bold The last team standing must still turn upon itself. Only one knight can leave champion. #!
russian: Большая меле проходит внутри пустого купола. Семьдесят семь рыцарей разделены на одиннадцать команд, сражаются верхом и пешими, пока не остаётся одна команда.\n\nАлисанна запретила моим Джонкиль Дарк и Тому Арфисту участвовать. Я не могу их винить — это зрелище очень похоже на войну. Последняя команда должна ещё повернуться друг против друга. Останется только один чемпион.

english:
By the end, the sand beneath the Dragonpit is churned to red mud.

Borys, Garon, and Ronnal Baratheon all make a brutal accounting of themselves. Harys Hogg, Alyn Bullock, Willam Stafford, Guyle the Cunning, and Alastor Reyne leave their marks as well. Two men are dead before the horns sound, and more than twoscore are carried or helped from the field.

Yet when the last shield is split and the last knight yields, it is Ser Lucamore Strong who remains standing. His helm is dented, his surcoat torn, and his grin entirely unrepentant as the crowd names him champion of the melee.

#bold The Dragonpit has seen its first blood, and the realm will speak of this day for years. #!
russian: Песок под куполом стал красной грязью. Баратеоны, Хогг, Буллок, Стаффорд, Хитрый Рейн — все оставили след. Двое убиты, более сорока вынесены с поля.\n\nПоследним стоит сир Люкамор Стронг — помятый, разорванный, но ухмыляющийся. Толпа называет его чемпионом меле. Драконья яма видела свою первую кровь, и королевство будет помнить этот день долго.

english:
Eight months into the great work on Rhaenys's Hill, and the first truth of building has announced itself: stone is cheap, but the men who shape it are not. The master of the stonemasons' guild comes before the throne, cap literally in hand, to report that the coin set aside for the foundations has run dry before the foundations have - and that half his best men are drifting off to easier work on merchants' manses.

The work will not stop, he hastens to add. It will merely... slow. Unless, of course, the crown wished to open its purse a little wider, in which case he could put three hundred more men on the hill by the new moon, working double shifts by torchlight.

#bold Every great work eats gold. The question is only how fast I wish it to eat. #!
russian: Восемь месяцев работы, и казна на фундаменты иссякла. Мастер гильдии просит больше золота — лучшие каменщики уходят на лёгкие работы в город.\n\nОн обещает утроить число рабочих, если корона откроет кошелёк. Каждое великое дело требует затрат. Вопрос лишь в том, насколько быстро я хочу его завершить.

english:
A ship out of Lys has brought a curious visitor to court: a master builder who names himself a descendant of the stonewrights of old Valyria, and who has heard - all the world has heard, it seems - that the dragon king is raising a great dome upon a hill. He has studied the drawings in the harbormaster's office, he says, uninvited, and pronounces them 'admirable, for Andal work.'

He then unrolls drawings of his own: cranes of a design our masons have never seen, scaffolds that climb with the wall, a method for raising the dome's ribs in half the time. The septons mutter about Valyrian sorcery; my own master builder mutters rather louder about foreign vultures. But I have looked at the drawings, and the drawings are #italic better#!.

#bold Genius asks a steep fee. It is still cheaper than mediocrity. #!
russian: Из Лиса прибыл мастер-строитель, потомок валирийских каменщиков. Он изучил наши чертежи и назвал их «восхитительными для андальской работы», а затем развернул свои — с кранами и лесами, вдвое ускоряющими работу.\n\nСептоны шепчут о колдовстве, мой мастер ворчит, но чертежи лучше наших. Гениальность стоит дорого, но это дешевле посредственности.

english:
The dome's great ribs stand against the sky now, and the whole city cranes its neck at them - but the walls beneath eat stone faster than the quarries of the Crownlands can cut it. The master of works lays the arithmetic before me: at the present rate of supply, the work will crawl for years yet, with the finest masons in the realm standing idle between barge-loads.

Or: the crown charters a fleet of stone-barges to run day and night from the deep quarries up the coast, and the flow of stone doubles. The harbourmasters have the ships. The quarrymen have the stone. All that is wanting, as ever, is the gold.

#bold I can see it finished from the walls of my keep - if I am willing to pay to see it sooner. #!
russian: Купол растёт, но стены под ним пожирают камень быстрее, чем каменоломни успевают поставлять. Мастер работ предлагает фрахтовать флот барж из глубоких каменоломен.\n\nУ начальников портов есть корабли, у каменщиков есть камень, но не хватает золота. Я хочу видеть купол завершённым — готов ли я заплатить за скорость?

english:
The master of works comes before the throne wearing the expression of a man who scarcely believes his own ledgers: the great work on Rhaenys's Hill is all but done - #bold years ahead of every projection#!.

The royal gold bore fruit. The extra crews, the foreign cranes, the barge-fleets of stone - each purchase fed the next, until the hill swarmed like a kicked anthill from first light to last torch. The last of the dome's plates is being set as he speaks; the great bronze doors are hung; the smiths are polishing the hinges.

#bold They said it would take the better part of a decade. Gold, well spent, is time. #!
russian: Мастер работ предстаёт с сияющим лицом: купол почти готов — на годы раньше срока. Дополнительные бригады, иностранные краны, флоты барж окупились.\n\nПоследняя плита укладывается, бронзовые двери висят на петлях. Говорили, что потребуется почти десять лет. Золото, хорошо потраченное, стало временем.

english:
The war for the throne is won before it is truly begun. Most of my uncle's supporters have fled the city; the few who remained, I have taken in chains.

Yet I am a boy of four-and-ten, and a boy cannot rule the Seven Kingdoms alone. So it is agreed. My mother, the Dowager Queen Alyssa Velaryon, shall rule as Queen Regent until I come of age. And Lord Rogar Baratheon of Storm's End - the strong sword who marched to set me upon the throne - I name Lord Protector of the Realm and Hand of the King, to guide my hand in the years to come.

#bold Together, we shall begin to bind the wounds my uncle left. #!
russian: Война за трон выиграна — сторонники Мейгора бежали или взяты в цепи. Но мне четырнадцать, и мальчик не может править один.\n\nМоя мать, королева Алисса, становится регентшей, а лорд Рогар Баратеон — Лордом-Протектором и Десницей. Вместе мы начнём залечивать раны, оставленные моим дядей.

english: The realm is full of men who served the Cruel - lords who bent the knee to my uncle, gaolers and confessors who tortured my brother Viserys to death in the black cells, and Maegor's own Kingsguard, white cloaks sworn to a monster.\n\nSome kneel and beg the black. Ser Harrold Langward, once Maegor's Lord Commander, kneels to no one - he denies my right to judge him and demands trial by combat. My mother and Lord Rogar counsel restraint, but the choice is mine alone. How shall the reign of Jaehaerys begin?
russian: Королевство полно людей, служивших Жестокому — лордов, тюремщиков, палачей и Королевскую гвардию Мейгора. Некоторые просят Стену, другие требуют суда.\n\nКак начнётся моё правление? Милосердием, мечом или прощением? Выбор за мной.

english:
Word comes from the south: Septon Moon is dead, and the Poor Fellows who besieged Oldtown have melted away like snow. The long war between the dragon and the Seven can end at last - if I will let it.

I will. I swear that the Iron Throne shall protect and defend the Faith of the Seven for all time - but I will not raise the Warrior's Sons and Poor Fellows again, and the Faith Militant shall lay down its swords forever. I lift my uncle Maegor's bounties from the heads of the faithful, and pardon all who repent; in return, the Most Devout acknowledge the King's justice, and the High Septon himself agrees to set the crown upon my head at the Starry Sept. The road to Oldtown lies open.

#bold Men will say I am a king who reconciles, not one who burns. #!
russian: Септон Мун мёртв, Бедные Собратья рассеялись. Долгая война между драконом и Верой может закончиться.\n\nЯ клянусь защищать Веру, но не воссоздам Сыновей Воина. Я снимаю награды с верующих и прощаю раскаявшихся. Верховный Септон соглашается короновать меня в Звёздной Септе. Пусть говорят, что я король, который примиряет, а не сжигает.

english:
The Golden Wedding done, Lord Rogar turns his ambition to me. A king must have a queen, he says, and my hand is the richest prize in the realm - a bride from Casterly Rock, perhaps, or Highgarden, to bind a great house to the throne. He has candidates already; my mother nods along. And for my sister Alysanne, some lord's heir far away.

They speak of alliances and armies. They do not speak of what Alysanne and I have known since we were children - that we love one another, and mean to wed no one else. I am the blood of the dragon, and the dragon does not bend to a Lord Protector's schemes.

#bold If they will not give us leave, we shall not ask it. #!
russian: Золотая свадьба окончена, и лорд Рогар теперь подыскивает мне невесту из Кастерли-Рока или Хайгардена, чтобы привязать великий дом к трону. Моя мать кивает. Для Алисанны он нашёл какого-то наследника лорда.\n\nОни говорят о союзах, но не знают, что мы с Алисанной любим друг друга и не намерены жениться ни на ком другом. Я кровь дракона — и не согнусь перед планами Протектора.

english:
We tell no one. In the black before dawn, Alysanne and I steal from the Red Keep to the dragonpit, where Vermithor and Silverwing wait. The Bronze Fury spreads his wings, my sister's she-dragon answers with a cry, and we are gone into the night sky before the regents so much as stir.

Beneath us King's Landing shrinks to a scatter of torches, then the black water of the bay, and then only the wind and the wings and Alysanne laughing beside me. We fly east, toward the ancient seat of our house, where no Hand and no Septon can keep us apart.

#bold To Dragonstone - and to each other. #!
russian: Перед рассветом мы крадёмся в Драконью яму, садимся на Вермитора и Сильвервинг и улетаем в ночь, пока регенты ещё спят.\n\nКоролевская Гавань становится россыпью огней, а затем мы летим на восток, к Драконьему Камню, где никто не сможет нас разлучить.

english:
The word reaches King's Landing within days, and the storm breaks. Lord Rogar is beside himself - cheated of his schemes, made a fool before the realm, roaring that the marriage must be annulled and the boy king brought to heel. My mother weeps, torn between her son and her new husband.

But rage as they might, the thing is done. I am wed, and soon I shall be a man grown and free of any regent's leash. Yet I am not blind: the Faith will not suffer a brother to bed his sister quietly. When I come into my crown in truth, the Seven will demand their reckoning - and I must be ready to answer it.

#bold The deed is done. Now let the Faith have its say. #!
russian: Весть достигает Королевской Гавани, и Рогар вне себя — он ревёт, что брак должен быть аннулирован, а меня наказать. Моя мать плачет, разрываясь между мной и мужем.\n\nНо дело сделано, и скоро я стану взрослым и свободным от регентства. Однако Вера не примет брат с сестрой легко — я должен быть готов ответить на их вызов.

english:
Balked of the marriage, Lord Rogar plays his last and boldest card. Before the small council he declares that a king who defies his Protector and beds his own sister is no fit king at all - and that the throne should pass to my niece Aerea, daughter of Aegon the Uncrowned, whose line ran senior to mine own. A girl of six, whom Rogar would rule through until she was grown and safely wed to a candidate of his choosing.

For a moment the chamber is silent. Then my mother the Queen Regent rises - and against her own husband, she speaks for me. One by one the council follows her: Lord Rogar's design is refused, and his reach for a puppet-queen dies on the council table.

#bold He has overreached, and the realm has seen it. #!
russian: Рогар заявляет в совете, что король, который ложится с сестрой, не годен править — и предлагает передать трон моей племяннице Аэрее, которой он правил бы как регент.\n\nНа мгновение тишина, затем моя мать встаёт против мужа и говорит за меня. Один за другим совет следует за ней: план Рогара отклонён. Он переоценил себя.

english:
On the twentieth day of the ninth moon, in the fiftieth year since my grandsire's Conquest, I turn six-and-ten upon the windswept rock of Dragonstone. I am a man grown now, in the eyes of gods and men alike, and the regency ends as all regencies must. No Protector rules in my name; no Hand schemes to unmake my marriage. Alysanne stands beside me, my queen in truth.

Before I go to claim my throne in earnest, I send five knights of my Kingsguard ahead to King's Landing, to see that all is made ready for the king's return. The Red Keep is to be swept and its gates thrown open. The dragon comes home.

#bold Ready the city. In three days I fly for the capital. #!
russian: На двадцатый день девятой луны мне исполняется шестнадцать. Регентство кончается, и я теперь взрослый мужчина. Алисанна стоит рядом со мной — моя королева.\n\nЯ посылаю пятерых рыцарей Кингсгард в Королевскую Гавань, чтобы подготовить город к моему возвращению. Через три дня я лечу в столицу.

english:
Three days after my nameday I mount Vermithor and take wing from Dragonstone, and the Bronze Fury bears me over the bay to King's Landing. The smallfolk crowd the streets to cheer as my dragon circles the hill of Aegon and settles in the yard of the Red Keep.

My mother is waiting for me. There has been coldness between us - her marriage to Rogar, his schemes, the crisis over my own wedding - but she is my mother still, and I am her son, and we have both grieved and lost too much to remain estranged. We speak long and privately, and when we are done, the breach between us is healed. Whatever passed between me and her husband, the Dowager Queen Alyssa Velaryon and her king are reconciled.

#bold She is my mother. There will be peace between us. #!
russian: Через три дня я сажусь на Вермитора и лечу в Королевскую Гавань. Простолюдины приветствуют меня на улицах, когда я приземляюсь во дворе Красного замка.\n\nМоя мать ждёт меня. Между нами был холод из-за Рогара, но она всё ещё моя мать, и мы примиряемся. Что бы ни случилось с её мужем, королева Алисса и её сын снова в мире.

english:
A king must be served by able men, and my uncle and the regency alike left me a council of the idle, the timid, and the merely fortunate. So I set to work. Some I dismiss outright; some I confirm in their offices, having proven their worth; and to the empty seats I raise men of my own choosing.

Hardest of all to replace is my master of coin, Lord Edwell Celtigar - a man as greedy as he is useless, who understands the counting of his own coppers far better than the treasury of a realm. For a time I despair of finding his equal in incompetence's opposite. In the end I look beyond Westeros entirely, and name a shrewd Pentoshi named Rego Draz to keep the Crown's gold. I fill the lesser offices with my own men, and open the black cells and dungeons of King's Landing, that my uncle's prisoners may see the sun again.

#bold A new council for a new reign. #!
russian: Регентство оставило мне совет из праздных и коррумпированных людей. Я увольняю одних, подтверждаю других и назначаю новых на пустующие места.\n\nВместо жадного лорда Эдвелла Селтигара я ставлю пентошийца Рего Драза мастером над монетой. Я открываю темницы и выпускаю узников моего дяди на свободу. Новый совет для нового правления.

english:
One matter remains: Lord Rogar Baratheon. I summon him to the throne room and receive him seated upon the Iron Throne, my council ranged about me, that all might see it is a king who judges him now and no boy. Rogar comes expecting harsh words, perhaps worse - and he is not wrong to fear, for he reached for my crown and would have set a child in my place.

Yet I have not forgotten the other truth: that when Maegor's shadow lay over us all, it was Rogar's strong sword that shielded me and mine, and set me on this throne. So I temper justice with memory. I will pardon him - upon his oath that he shall never again speak a word against me or my queen, and that he shall be an honourable husband to my mother. And his brother Orryn, who on Rogar's word tried to steal the novice Rhaella from her motherhouse to raise a rival against me, I sentence to ten years' exile beyond the narrow sea.

When Rogar, humbled, asks whether the Crown will require hostages of House Baratheon, I say nothing. I only rise, and lead him out to where Vermithor waits - and let the Bronze Fury make my answer for me.

#bold Kneel, my lord, and let this be the end of it. #!
russian: Я вызываю Рогара Баратеона на Железный Трон. Он ожидает сурового приговора за попытку посадить на трон Аэрею. Но я помню, что именно его меч защитил меня при Мейгоре.\n\nЯ помилую его при условии, что он поклянётся в верности и будет честным мужем для моей матери. Его брата Оррина, пытавшегося похитить послушницу Рейлу, я изгоняю на десять лет. Когда Рогар спрашивает о заложниках, я веду его к Вермитору — и Бронзовая Ярость отвечает за меня.

english:
The Protectorship is ended and the office of the Hand stands empty. Rogar Baratheon taught me the danger of a Hand who is also the mightiest lord in the realm, with armies and ambitions of his own. This time I will have a Hand who serves the Crown and not himself - a steady man, wise in coin and law and the workings of the realm, whom I can trust as I trust few others.

I find him near to home. Lord Daemon Velaryon of Driftmark, the Lord of the Tides and my mother's kinsman, has served ably as my master of ships. He is no warlord and no schemer, only a capable and loyal man - and that is precisely what I need. I name him Hand of the King, and so begins a partnership that I mean to last the length of my reign.

#bold Rise, Lord Daemon, Hand of the King. #!
russian: Протекторат окончен, и должность Десницы пустует. Рогар Баратеон научил меня опасности Десницы-лорда с собственными амбициями. Мне нужен человек, который служит Короне, а не себе.\n\nЯ назначаю лорда Деймона Велариона с Дрифтмарка — моего мастера над кораблями, верного и способного. Он не военачальник и не интриган, но именно такого человека я хочу видеть своей правой рукой.

english:
My new master of coin proves his worth at once. Lord Rego - for I have raised the Pentoshi to a lordship, that the Iron Throne need not blush to be served by him - stems the bleeding of the Crown's debts, enough that the great works upon Rhaenys's Hill may resume. But it is not enough to see the Dragonpit finished, and so together we devise a cleverer way to fill the coffers.

We lay a tax upon luxuries and exotic goods - Myrish lace and Volantene silk, Qartheen spices and Lyseni perfumes. It touches no smallfolk, and no honest lord shall feel it; only those who would flaunt their wealth and splendour before the world. And flaunt it they will, Rego assures me, laughing - a vain man will pay any price to be envied. He is right. The coppers become dragons, and the dragons a river of gold.

To this I add a second tax, with a purpose beyond mere coin: henceforth any lord who would raise a new castle, or repair or enlarge an old one, shall pay a heavy toll reckoned by the count of his crenellations. The great lords will think twice before raising their walls higher - and pay the Crown handsomely if they do.

#bold The treasury swells, and the Dragonpit shall be finished after all. #!
russian: Мой новый мастер над монетой Рего Драз быстро останавливает утечку казны. Мы вместе придумываем налог на роскошь и экзотические товары — он не касается простолюдинов, только тех, кто выставляет богатство напоказ.\n\nЯ также ввожу пошлину на строительство новых замков и укреплений, исчисляемую по количеству зубцов. Пусть великие лорды платят Короне, если хотят возводить стены. Казна наполняется, и Драконья яма будет достроена.

english:
Half a year after I came at last to King's Landing, Alysanne departs Dragonstone to join me, and a moon's turn later we are wed a second time - not in secret as before, but openly, before the Iron Throne and the eyes of the realm. There can be no whispering now that the King and Queen are not truly married.

The rites are performed by a septon new-come to my service: Barth, a smith's son of humble birth and boundless mind, the most learned man I have ever met. I mark him well; I think he shall rise far. The ceremony itself is a modest thing - the treasury is bare, and barely a thousand guests attend, a poor show beside the splendour of Rogar and my mother's Golden Wedding. Yet I would not trade it for a thousand golden weddings.

Alysanne is my sister, my queen, and my truest friend in all the world; there is no one living who knows my heart as she does, nor I hers. That night, as man and wife before gods and men at last, we lie together.

#bold Whatever storms may come, we shall face them as one. #!
russian: Через полгода Алисанна приезжает в Королевскую Гавань, и мы венчаемся во второй раз — открыто, перед Железным Троном и всем королевством. Обряд совершает септон Барт, учёнейший человек, которого я встречал.\n\nЦеремония скромна — казна пуста, и гостей едва ли тысяча, но я не променял бы её на тысячу золотых свадеб. Алисанна — моя сестра, королева и вернейший друг. Какие бы бури ни пришли, мы встретим их как одно целое.

english:
Lord Daemon Velaryon has served the crown long and faithfully, but the Lord of the Tides grows old, and the tides call him home. The realm expects me to reach for a great lord to take up the chain - a Tully, a Tyrell, an Arryn, some proud name with proud banners.

The realm will be disappointed. There is one man at this court who has read every book in the Red Keep's library and written better ones; who argued the Doctrine with septons and the harbor accounts with Rego Draz, and bested both; who fears neither gods, nor lords, nor telling his king that his king is wrong. He is the son of a blacksmith. He wears a septon's robes. And he has the finest mind I have ever met.

The great lords may gnash their teeth. Wisdom does not wear a house's colors.

#bold Septon Barth shall be my Hand. The realm will laugh - and then, for forty years, it will marvel. #!
russian: Лорд Деймон Веларион стареет и уходит на покой. Королевство ждёт, что я назначу великого лорда — Талли, Тайрелла, Аррена.\n\nНо я выбираю септона Барта — сына кузнеца, хранителя библиотеки, человека, который превзошёл учёных и не боится правды. Великие лорды будут скрежетать зубами, но мудрость не носит цвета дома. Барт станет моей Десницей.

english:
The Handship stands empty, and the realm expects me to reach for a great lord to fill it - a Tully, a Tyrell, an Arryn, some proud name with proud banners.

The realm will be disappointed. There is one man at this court who has read every book in the Red Keep's library and written better ones; who argued the Doctrine with septons and the harbor accounts with Rego Draz, and bested both; who fears neither gods, nor lords, nor telling his king that his king is wrong. He is the son of a blacksmith. He wears a septon's robes. And he has the finest mind I have ever met.

The great lords may gnash their teeth. Wisdom does not wear a house's colors.

#bold Septon Barth shall be my Hand. The realm will laugh - and then, for forty years, it will marvel. #!
russian: Должность Десницы пустует. Королевство ждёт великого лорда, но я выбираю септона Барта — сына кузнеца, самого блестящего ума при дворе.\n\nОн читал все книги и переспорил септонов и купцов. Пусть лорды скрежещут зубами — мудрость не носит цвета дома. Барт станет моей Десницей.

english:
The letter comes up from the rookery with frost still on the seal, and I read it twice before I let myself believe it.

Ser Olyver Bracken and Ser Raymund Mallery — Maegor's men, the two I spared, the two I sent to the Wall so that some good might yet be wrung out of them — have risen against their own order. Bracken has made himself a lord in all but name at Rimegate; Mallery schemes at Sable Hall. Black brothers loyal to their vows have died at the hands of black brothers who kept none.

My mercy did this. I gave them their lives, and they have spent them like counterfeit coin. The North is already stirring — the Starks do not wait on southern leave where the Wall is concerned.
russian: Письмо с инеем на печати: сер Оливер Бракен и сер Раймунд Маллери — люди Мейгора, которых я пощадил и отправил к Стене — восстали. Бракен захватил Римгейт, Маллери — Сейбл-Холл. Верные братья пали от рук своих же.\n\nМоё милосердие сотворило это. Север уже шевелится — Старки не ждут южного позволения, когда речь идёт о Стене.

english:
The letter comes up from the rookery with frost still on the seal.

Ser Olyver Bracken — Maegor's man, the knight I spared and sent to the Wall — has risen against his own order and made himself master of Rimegate. Black brothers loyal to their vows have died at the hands of black brothers who kept none.

My mercy did this. I gave him his life, and he has spent it like counterfeit coin. The North is already stirring — the Starks do not wait on southern leave where the Wall is concerned.
russian: Письмо с инеем на печати: сер Оливер Бракен — человек Мейгора, которого я пощадил — восстал и захватил Римгейт. Верные братья пали от его рук.\n\nМоё милосердие сотворило это. Север уже шевелится.

english:
The letter comes up from the rookery with frost still on the seal.

Ser Raymund Mallery — Maegor's man, the knight I spared and sent to the Wall — has raised the garrison of Sable Hall against its own officers. Black brothers loyal to their vows have died at the hands of black brothers who kept none.

My mercy did this. I gave him his life, and he has spent it like counterfeit coin. The North is already stirring — the Starks do not wait on southern leave where the Wall is concerned.
russian: Письмо с инеем на печати: сер Раймунд Маллери — человек Мейгора, которого я пощадил — поднял гарнизон Сейбл-Холла. Верные братья пали.\n\nМоё милосердие сотворило это. Север уже шевелится.

english: Word follows word up the kingsroad. Lord Walton Stark has not waited — not for my leave, not for the spring. He has called his banners in the yard where his father's bones were barely cold, taken the great blade Ice off its iron pins, and ridden north with hard men and remounts through snow a southern host would call impassable.\n\nThe free folk have a saying, the maesters tell me: the Wall is the world's edge. The Starks have a shorter one. The Wall is ours.
russian: Лорд Уолтон Старк не ждал — ни моего позволения, ни весны. Он созвал знамёна, взял Лёд и поскакал на север с суровыми людьми и запасными лошадьми по снегам.\n\nУ вольного народа есть поговорка: Стена — край мира. У Старков — короче. Стена — наша.

english: Word follows word up the kingsroad. Winterfell has not waited — not for my leave, not for the spring. The North's banners are called, and hard men with remounts push north through snow a southern host would call impassable, loyal black brothers riding at their side.\n\nThe free folk have a saying, the maesters tell me: the Wall is the world's edge. The Starks have a shorter one. The Wall is ours.
russian: Винтерфелл не ждал. Знамена Севера созваны, суровые люди пробиваются на север через снега, верные чёрные братья едут рядом.\n\nСтена — наша.

english:
It is done at Rimegate, and it is done the northern way.

The mutineers held the gate two days. On the third, the loyal brothers came over the ice-slick walls with Lord Stark's men behind them, and by dusk Ser Olyver Bracken knelt in the snow of the yard he had claimed as his own. There was no trial by combat this time, no plea of old service. Lord Walton Stark heard his crimes read, took Ice in both hands, and struck the head from the man my mercy had made.

They tell me the Lord of Winterfell said only this, after: 'He died quicker than the men he betrayed.'
russian: Мятежники держали ворота два дня. На третий верные братья перешли через стены с людьми Старка, и к вечеру Бракен преклонил колени в снегу. На этот раз не было суда. Лорд Уолтон взял Лёд и отсёк голову человеку, которого сделало моё милосердие.\n\n«Он умер быстрее, чем люди, которых он предал».

english: It is done at Rimegate, and it is done the northern way.\n\nThe mutineers held the gate two days. On the third, the loyal brothers came over the ice-slick walls with the North's men behind them, and by dusk Ser Olyver Bracken knelt in the snow of the yard he had claimed as his own. There was no trial by combat this time, no plea of old service. The Lord Commander heard his crimes read and struck the head from the man my mercy had made.
russian: Мятежники держали ворота два дня. На третий верные братья перешли через стены с людьми Севера, и Бракен пал. Лорд-Командующий отсёк голову человеку, которого сделало моё милосердие.

english: Sable Hall did not fight. When word of Rimegate reached them, Ser Raymund Mallery and the last of the mutineers went over the Wall in the night — down the ice by rope and into the haunted forest, where no king's law and no lord's either has ever followed.\n\nExcept that Lord Walton Stark means to follow. His officers counselled against it; the black brothers counselled against it; the wildling guides refused outright. He is taking picked men beyond the Wall all the same. Oathbreakers who flee the king's justice, he is said to have answered, do not stop being oathbreakers for standing on the far side of it.
russian: Сейбл-Холл не сражался. Когда весть о Римгейте достигла их, Маллери и мятежники ночью перебрались через Стену — в Зачарованный лес.\n\nНо лорд Уолтон намерен следовать. Клятвопреступники, бегущие от королевского правосудия, не перестают быть клятвопреступниками от того, что стоят по ту сторону.

english:
The survivors speak of it in pieces, and the pieces do not fit together into anything a sane man wants to see whole.

They caught the mutineers' trail in the haunted forest and followed it three days into country where the trees grow older than kingdoms. On the fourth day the forest stood up. Giants — not the fireside kind, but grey-skinned and tree-tall and terrible — came out of the white silence onto the column, and the world became clubs and screaming and the smell of split pine.

They say Lord Walton Stark killed two of them. They say it took that many to bring him down. They brought back what they could carry.
russian: Выжившие говорят обрывками. Они нашли след мятежников в лесу, три дня шли по следу. На четвёртый день лес встал — великаны, серокожие, ростом с дерево, вышли из белой тишины.\n\nЛорд Уолтон Старк убил двух из них. Говорят, потребовалось столько, чтобы сразить его.

english:
They carried the Lord of Winterfell home to Castle Black in pieces, wrapped in his own cloak. The loyal brothers stood to honour him at the gate; the survivors of the ranging will wear the memory longer than any scar. Of Ser Raymund Mallery the wildlings later told a ranger, laughing, that the kneelers who came over the Wall had been guests at a feast — and what the feast was, I will not put to parchment.

Alaric Stark is Lord of Winterfell now. His letter acknowledging my titles is three lines long, correct in every particular, and colder than anything the Wall has ever felt.

He does not say that my mercy killed his brother. He does not need to.
russian: Они принесли Лорда Винтерфелла домой по частям, завёрнутым в его плащ. О Маллери дикие рассказали, смеясь, что коленопреклонённые были гостями на пиру — и что это был за пир, я не запишу.\n\nАларик Старк теперь Лорд Винтерфелла. Его письмо корректно и холоднее самой Стены. Он не говорит, что моё милосердие убило его брата. Ему не нужно.

english:
I spared those men. Whatever they burn, whatever they break, the fire starts with me — and I will not sit in the Red Keep tallying northern dead by raven while other men pay my debts.

Vermithor rises through the cold in great bronze surges, the kingsroad a grey thread below and the snows beyond it whiter than any parchment. The Wall, when it first shows on the horizon, is a line of light like the edge of a blade.

Bracken will look up from his stolen castle and see what mercy looks like when it comes back.
russian: Я пощадил тех людей. Я не буду сидеть в Красном Замке, пока другие платят мои долги.\n\nВермитор поднимается сквозь холод. Стена — линия света на горизонте. Пусть Бракен увидит, как выглядит милосердие, когда оно возвращается.

english:
There was no battle. There was never going to be a battle.

Vermithor came down on Rimegate's yard with a sound like the world tearing, and the mutiny ended in the time it took frightened men to open a gate. Lord Walton Stark's column, still a day's ride south, arrived to find the mutineers kneeling in rows in the snow and a dragon steaming on the ice like a mountain of banked coals.

Ser Olyver Bracken received from me at Rimegate what I should perhaps have given him beneath the Red Keep: the King's justice, delivered by the King. I did not sleep after. But no Stark died for my mercy, and no black brother either — not one, from the hour I landed.
russian: Не было битвы. Вермитор опустился на двор, и мятеж закончился. Колонна Старка прибыла и увидела мятежников на коленях в снегу.\n\nБракен получил королевское правосудие. Ни один Старк не умер из-за моего милосердия. Это мне предстояло закончить.

english:
Ser Raymund Mallery went over the Wall before Vermithor's shadow ever touched Sable Hall, and there even a dragon does not follow — Vermithor would not take the ice line, and the rangers went afoot in his stead. What they brought back was a tale from the free folk, told laughing: the kneeler knight who fled the dragon had been a guest at a wildling feast, and had not left it.

Lord Walton Stark rode with me to Castle Black gate. A hard man, as they said — but at the parting he set his fist to his chest, which his household tells me he has done for no man since his father.

'You came yourself,' he said. 'The North does not forget that.'
russian: Маллери перебрался через Стену прежде, чем тень Вермитора коснулась Сейбл-Холла. Даже дракон не следует туда. Следопыты пошли пешком и вернулись с рассказом: беглец был гостем на диком пиру и не покинул его.\n\nЛорд Уолтон поехал со мной к воротам Чёрного Замка. «Вы пришли сами, — сказал он. — Север этого не забывает».

english:
Ten years a king, and I have never seen the North. Alysanne says it plainly, over the maps: one realm cannot be half a realm the king has never stood in.

So: a great progress, to White Harbor and Winterfell and the Wall itself. And this time I mean to be clever about it. On every progress I have made, Vermithor lands and then I wait a week for my own baggage. No more. The retinue, the wardrobe, the cooks, the gifts — all of it goes AHEAD, by ship to White Harbor, and the dragons catch the column on the road.

The Queen is already choosing her ladies. She has wanted the North for years.
russian: Десять лет король, и я никогда не видел Севера. Алисанна говорит прямо: одно королевство не может быть полукоролевством, в котором король никогда не стоял.\n\nВеликий прогресс — в Белую Гавань, Винтерфелл и Стену. На этот раз я поступлю умно: свита вперёд на кораблях, драконы догонят. Королева уже выбирает дам.

english:
The retinue's sails are barely over the horizon when the Free Cities arrive in my throne room.

Pentos and Tyrosh have spent three years strangling each other's trade — and half the narrow sea's with it. Now both send magisters, silk-wrapped and desperate, to beg the Iron Throne to sit between them and make a peace. It is a great honour, Barth says. It is a great snare, I say: such negotiations run long, and Winterfell is expecting me.

Alysanne cuts the knot as she always does. 'Then I shall go ahead, and you will catch me up when the ink is dry. Cancel a progress on the Starks? I would sooner insult the Wall itself.'
russian: Паруса свиты скрылись, когда Вольные Города явились в мой зал. Пентос и Тирош три года душат друг друга и просят Железный Трон сесть между ними. Барт говорит, это честь; я говорю, ловушка.\n\nАлисанна рубит узел: «Я поеду вперёд, ты догонишь». Отменить прогресс у Старков? Я скорее оскорблю саму Стену.

english:
She goes down to the ships in the grey of morning with her ladies and her septas and half the gaiety of the court, and the docks have never been louder.

Silverwing does not take ship, of course. She circles the harbour once as the fleet stands out into the bay, silver-and-blue against the clouds, and the sailors swear the Queen's dragon means to shepherd the convoy the whole way north like a hound with her flock.

The Red Keep is very quiet by evening. I had not thought to mind it so much.
russian: Она спускается к кораблям в сером утре со своими дамами и половиной веселья двора. Серебряное Крыло кружит над гаванью, сопровождая конвой.\n\nКрасный Замок к вечеру тих. Я не думал, что буду так скучать.

english:
Her first letter comes up from White Harbor, and I can hear her laughing through the ink.

The Manderlys have outdone themselves — a city scrubbed white as its name, mermen on every banner, a feast of lamprey and winter ale that her ladies will be recovering from for a week. And, being Alysanne, she has already done the thing no king's progress ever did: thrown open the New Castle's hall to the women of the city, high and low together, and simply listened.

The last line of her letter is less merry. 'Some of what they tell me, my love, you will need to hear. Not yet. When I am home.'
russian: Её первое письмо из Белой Гавани: Мандерли превзошли себя, пир из миноги и зимнего эля. Она уже открыла зал Нового Замка для женщин города и просто слушала.\n\nПоследняя строка менее весёлая: «Кое-что из того, что они мне рассказали, тебе нужно будет услышать. Не сейчас. Когда я вернусь домой».

english:
Winterfell, her raven says, received her with careful courtesy and a reserve that is almost, but not quite, warmth.

Lord Walton Stark is not a man who smiles at strangers — but he remembers a king who came north on dragonback to answer his own mistake, and his welcome says so in a hundred small wordless ways. It is his court that stays wary: southern queens and their silks sit oddly in a hall hung with iron swords.

'They watch me like a hawk in a henyard,' Alysanne writes, 'but the lord tells his people you came to the Wall yourself when it mattered. We begin better than I had hoped.'
russian: Винтерфелл принял её с тщательной учтивостью и сдержанностью, почти тёплой. Лорд Уолтон помнит короля, который пришёл на север на драконе исправить свою ошибку.\n\n«Они следят за мной, но лорд говорит, что ты сам пришёл к Стене, когда это было важно. Мы начинаем лучше, чем я надеялась».

english:
Winterfell, her raven says, received her with correct courtesy and the particular caution the North keeps for southern power.

Lord Walton Stark is a hard man to read, Alysanne writes, but there is no grief in the hall and no grudge under it — only the old northern wariness of dragons. Once, over the wine, he even offered her something like approval: his father Brandon had told him of the King's justice on Maegor's men. 'Heads, not pardons,' the old lord had said. 'The dragon judged those knights as WE would have judged them.'

'Give me a fortnight,' she writes, 'and I will have him telling me his grandfather's hunting stories.'
russian: Винтерфелл принял её с учтивостью и осторожностью. Лорд Уолтон — трудный человек, но однажды за вином он даже предложил одобрение: его отец Брандон говорил о королевском правосудии над людьми Мейгора.\n\n«Дай мне две недели, — пишет она, — и я заставлю его рассказывать мне охотничьи истории».

english:
Winterfell, her raven says, received her with every correct courtesy and precious little warmth.

The Lord of Winterfell met her in his yard, named her titles precisely, saw her retinue housed — and then gave her days of grey northern silence. It is not enmity, her letter insists; it is the North's way with strangers, and a Targaryen queen with a dragon overhead is the strangest guest Winterfell has kept in living memory.

'Ice melts,' she writes. 'It only wants patience.'
russian: Винтерфелл принял её с учтивостью и драгоценно малым теплом. Лорд встретил её, дал дни серого северного молчания. Это не вражда, пишет она; это северный способ общения с незнакомцами.\n\n«Лёд тает. Ему нужно только терпение».

english:
The next raven is a different bird entirely.

She has done it. Not with gifts — the North cannot be bought, she writes, and despises the attempt — but by being relentlessly, unanswerably herself. She rode out with the hunt in weather that sent half her ladies to bed. She matched the Lord of Winterfell cup for cup with honest praise for northern ale, asked after his household by name, listened to an old dispute over winter grain stores and settled it so neatly that two of his bannermen now swear by her.

And at the last, the hall watching, she set Silverwing down INSIDE the walls of Winterfell and bid the children of the castle come and touch a living dragon. 'The Lord of Winterfell laughed,' she writes, and underlines it twice. 'His own household says they had not heard it since he came to the lordship.'
russian: Следующий ворон — совсем другая птица. Она сделала это: выехала на охоту в погоду, от которой её дамы слёгли, пила с лордом, называла его домочадцев по именам, уладила старый спор.\n\nПод конец она посадила Серебряное Крыло ВНУТРИ стен и велела детям подойти и потрогать дракона. Лорд Винтерфелла засмеялся — впервые с тех пор, как стал лордом.

english:
From Winterfell she does the thing her escort dreaded and her letters had promised all along: she leaves them.

Silverwing rises out of the grey stone circle of Winterfell into a sky like polished steel, and the Queen of the Seven Kingdoms flies the kingsroad's long ghost north over the last farms, the last holdfasts, the last trees — to where the world simply stops. Her escort will be a fortnight catching her up. She means to spend that fortnight among the black brothers of Castle Black.

'The lords were scandalized,' her letter says. 'The smallfolk cheered. I find I am with the smallfolk.'
russian: Из Винтерфелла она делает то, чего её эскорт боялся: она покидает их. Серебряное Крыло поднимается в небо, и Королева летит на север, к Чёрному Замку. Эскорт догонит через две недели.\n\n«Лорды были шокированы, — пишет она. — Простой народ приветствовал. Я оказываюсь с простым народом».

english:
From Winterfell she does the thing her escort dreaded and I, if I am honest, had promised myself she would not: she leaves us.

Silverwing rises out of the grey stone circle of Winterfell into a sky like polished steel, and my Queen flies the kingsroad's long ghost north over the last farms, the last holdfasts, the last trees — to where the world simply stops. 'You have your lords to win,' she told me in the yard, pulling on her gloves, 'and I have my black brothers. We will trade tales when I am back.'

Her escort will be a fortnight catching her up. She does not intend to wait for them.
russian: Из Винтерфелла она покидает нас. Серебряное Крыло поднимается в небо, и она летит на север. «У тебя есть свои лорды, чтобы завоевать, а у меня — чёрные братья».\n\nЭскорт догонит через две недели. Она не намерена ждать.

english:
The Watch feasts her at Castle Black on salt beef, black bread and perfect honesty — and she is, she writes, entirely conquered.

But the Wall keeps its ledger too. At table an old ranger spoke, carefully, of the mutiny: of Rimegate, of the brothers who died holding to their vows, of Lord Walton Stark carried home in pieces because two of Maegor's pardoned knights thought the black too poor a coat. The Lord Commander silenced him with a look — but the silence after, she writes, had weight.

'They are too courteous to say it to their Queen. I will say it to my King. The Watch paid for the white cloaks you spared, my love. They know it. So must we.'
russian: Дозор пирует её солёной говядиной и чёрным хлебом. Но Стена ведёт свой счёт: старый следопыт заговорил о мятеже, о братьях, погибших, о лорде Уолтоне, унесённом по частям.\n\n«Они слишком учтивы, чтобы сказать это своей королеве. Дозор заплатил за белые плащи, которых вы пощадили».

english:
The Watch feasts her at Castle Black on salt beef, black bread and perfect honesty — and she is, she writes, entirely conquered.

And here, at the world's edge, your name is good coin, my love. The older brothers still tell it: the winter the pardoned knights rose, and the king who did not send a raven or an army but came HIMSELF, bronze wings over Rimegate, and ended it before the North had buried a single loyal man. The Old Bear of a Lord Commander they had then is dead, but his saying survives him: 'The Iron Throne remembered us once. See that you are worth remembering twice.'

'They drink to you here,' she writes. 'I thought you should know that somewhere in your realm, men in black drink to the King.'
russian: Дозор пирует её. Здесь твоё имя — хорошая монета. Старшие братья помнят: король, который пришёл САМ, с бронзовыми крыльями над Римгейтом.\n\n«Они пьют за тебя здесь, — пишет она. — Люди в чёрном пьют за Короля».

english:
The Watch feasts her at Castle Black on salt beef, black bread and perfect honesty — and she is, she writes, entirely conquered.

One thing surprised her. She had expected, delicately, some grievance over Maegor's knights — the white cloaks who might have come to the Wall and did not, because the King gave them the sword instead. She found the opposite. 'Kings mean well when they empty their dungeons on us,' the Lord Commander told her over the wine. 'They send us their traitors and call it mercy. Your king sent us no one he could not trust to us. The Watch has thanked worse men for better gifts.'

'It seems,' she writes, 'that the harder choice was the kinder one, here. I am still deciding what I think of that.'
russian: Дозор пирует её. Она ожидала обиды из-за рыцарей Мейгора, но нашла обратное: король не прислал им никого, кому нельзя было бы доверять.\n\n«Более трудный выбор оказался здесь более добрым. Я всё ещё решаю, что об этом думать».

english:
The Watch feasts her at Castle Black on salt beef, black bread and perfect honesty — and she is, she writes, entirely conquered.

At table there was one hard toast. Maegor's knights, the ones the King spared and sent across the narrow sea — the Watch has heard the tales of them selling their swords in Essos, oathless and comfortable, and the black brothers find it bitter beer. 'Every lordling in chains is offered the Wall,' an old ranger said. 'It seems a white cloak buys a softer sentence.' The Lord Commander did not silence him.

'They would have taken those knights, my love,' she writes, 'and been glad of the swords. Remember the Wall, next time mercy is in your gift.'
russian: Дозор пирует её. Был один жёсткий тост: рыцари Мейгора, которых Король пощадил и отправил в Эссос, продают свои мечи в комфорте. Чёрные братья находят это горьким.\n\n«Они взяли бы тех рыцарей и были бы рады мечам. Помни о Стене, когда в следующий раз милость будет в твоём даре».

english:
The Watch feasts her at Castle Black on salt beef, black bread and perfect honesty — and she is, she writes, entirely conquered.

They showed her the ice cells and the winch cage, the armory with its thousand old swords, the ledgers with their terrible arithmetic: a Wall built for ten thousand held by hundreds. She asked the Lord Commander what the Watch needed and he laughed and said 'everything', and then, seeing her face, stopped laughing and began to answer honestly. The list ran to a second sheet.

'I came north expecting to admire a wonder,' she writes. 'I have found nine hundred poor and honest men holding up the sky, and I mean to do something about it.'
russian: Дозор пирует её. Они показали ей ледяные камеры и клетку-подъёмник, реестры: Стена, построенная для десяти тысяч, удерживаемая сотнями.\n\n«Я приехала на север ожидая чудо, — пишет она. — Я нашла девятьсот бедных и честных людей, удерживающих небо».

english:
One letter I will keep until I die.

'Three times I put her at it, my love. Three times. I meant only to fly beyond the Wall and back — to see the haunted forest from above, to say a queen had done it. Silverwing has never refused me anything. She refused me this. Each time we came over that ice she screamed and shore away south, and no urging of mine could hold her to the line. The third time I felt it myself — I cannot write what it was. A cold that is not cold. A NO as wide as the world.

Whatever the Wall is, Jaehaerys, it is not only ice. Our dragons know something we do not. I sat in the snow at Castle Black a long while after, and the Lord Commander said nothing, and I was grateful to him for it.'
russian: Одно письмо я сохраню до смерти. «Три раза я подводила её к этому. Она отказала мне в этом. Каждый раз она с криком уходила на юг. В третий раз я сама это почувствовала — холод, который не есть холод.\n\nЧем бы ни была Стена, это не просто лёд. Наши драконы знают что-то, чего не знаем мы».

english:
She is back at Winterfell when the long letter comes — the one she promised at White Harbor, written in a harder hand than her usual.

At every stop of this progress she has held her women's courts: the hall cleared of lords, the doors opened to any woman who would speak, from the fishwives of White Harbor to the black brothers' washerwomen of Mole's Town. Two things fill the letter. The first is the Watch: nine hundred men holding a hundred leagues of ice on a beggar's portion, while good land south of the Wall lies under lords who never look north. She has an idea about that, she writes, and I am to be ambushed with it at Winterfell.

The second thing she will not put in writing at all. 'It concerns an old right of lords, and the women it is used upon. When you have heard what I have heard, you will end it. I know you.'
russian: Она вернулась в Винтерфелл с длинным письмом — тем, что обещала в Белой Гавани. На каждой остановке она проводила женские суды: две вещи наполняют письмо. Первая — Дозор: девятьсот человек держат сто льё льда на нищенской доле. У неё есть идея.\n\nВторую она не запишет: она касается старого права лордов. «Когда ты услышишь то, что услышала я, ты покончишь с ним».

english:
She comes back to Winterfell out of a snow squall, wind-burned and grave, and that first evening she does not tell stories at table the way she has at every other stop of this progress.

Later, by the fire in our chambers, she gives me both halves of what the North has given her. The first is the Watch: nine hundred men holding a hundred leagues of ice on a beggar's portion, while good land south of the Wall lies under lords who never look north. She has an idea about that, and she means to make it in front of Lord Stark's whole court, where it cannot be quietly declined.

The second she says very quietly, watching the fire. 'It concerns an old right of lords, and the women it is used upon. When we are home, my love, I will tell you what my women's courts have told me — and then you will end it. I know you.'
russian: Она возвращается в Винтерфелл из снежного шквала, обветренная и серьёзная. У камина она отдаёт мне обе половины: первая — Дозор и Новый Дар; вторая — старая право лордов.\n\n«Когда мы будем дома, я расскажу тебе, а затем ты покончишь с этим».

english:
Two months, now. Two months of Pentoshi arithmetic and Tyroshi theatre.

Every point conceded is reopened the next morning in different silks. The Tyroshi archon's men walked out twice this week over the wording of a preamble — a PREAMBLE — and the Pentoshi magisters smiled so widely at that reversal that I nearly had the whole pack of them shipped home in the same hull to finish their war at sea.

And every third day a raven from the North lands like sunlight on this table: my Queen is winning Winterfell, feasting with black brothers, flying at the edge of the world. Half a year I promised her at most. The ink is nowhere near dry.
russian: Два месяца пентошской арифметики и тирошского театра. Каждая уступка на следующее утро открывается заново. Люди архонта выходили дважды из-за формулировки преамбулы.\n\nИ каждый третий день ворон с Севера: моя королева покоряет Винтерфелл, пирует с чёрными братьями, летает на край света.

english:
Done. Signed, sealed, sworn before gods old, new and whatever the Tyroshi keep in those painted temples of theirs. Pentos and Tyrosh have their peace; the narrow sea has its trade lanes back; the Iron Throne has the thanks of two Free Cities and, rather more usefully, their tariff concessions.

Half a year, near enough to make no matter. Alysanne left in one season and writes to me from another.

Winterfell is a long way north, and I am done with waiting.
russian: Сделано. Подписано, скреплено печатями. У Пентоса и Тироша теперь мир, Железный Трон получил тарифные уступки. Полгода почти без разницы.\n\nВинтерфелл далеко на севере, и я устал ждать.

english:
Lord Alaric Stark receives me in the yard of Winterfell with every honour the law requires and not one gesture more.

His courtesies are exact. His eyes are his brother's tomb. Alysanne warned me — half a year of her warmth has bought me the difference between hostility and correctness, no further — and still the cold of that yard reaches through the furs. This is the lord whose brother rode north to clean up after MY mercy and came home in pieces.

At the doors he pauses. 'Before you feast, Your Grace,' he says, 'there is a thing in the crypts I would show you. It will not take long. The dead keep short courts.'
russian: Лорд Аларик принимает меня со всеми почестями и ни одним жестом больше. Его учтивости точны. Его глаза — могила брата. Алисанна предупреждала: холод того двора проникает сквозь меха.\n\n«Прежде чем вы будете пировать, — говорит он, — есть вещь в склепах. Мёртвые ведут короткие суды».

english:
Lord Walton Stark receives me in the yard of Winterfell, and for a moment the grim face and the grey furs are all I see — and then he does the thing his whole court plainly did not expect: he comes down the steps and clasps my arm like a comrade.

'The last time I saw Your Grace,' he says, 'you were a length of bronze wings over Rimegate, and the worst winter's work of my life was ended before my column ever reached it. I have told the tale often. Now they can all stop believing I invented it.'

Behind him, Alysanne is laughing. The North is cold. This hall, tonight, will not be.
russian: Лорд Уолтон принимает меня на дворе, и он делает то, чего никто не ждал: сжимает мою руку. «В последний раз я видел вас над Римгейтом. Теперь все могут перестать верить, что я выдумал эту историю».\n\nПозади него смеётся Алисанна. Этот зал сегодня вечером не будет холоден.

english:
Lord Walton Stark receives me in the yard of Winterfell with the grave, unhurried courtesy of a man who kneels rarely and means it when he does.

'My father Brandon spoke of you, Your Grace,' he says as we climb the steps. 'He came home from the Golden Wedding saying the south had made itself a proper king at last — one who gave Maegor's dogs heads instead of pardons. He said the North judges a man by what he does with a sword when a debt is owed. He judged you fit.'

From a Stark, Alysanne murmurs at my shoulder, that is a wedding feast, a tourney and a triumph all together.
russian: Лорд Уолтон принимает меня с серьёзной учтивостью. «Мой отец Брандон говорил о вас: юг наконец сделал себе настоящего короля, который дал псам Мейгора головы вместо помилований».\n\nОт Старка, шепчет Алисанна, это и свадебный пир, и триумф вместе.

english:
Winterfell receives us both in a yard swept clean as a sept floor, and the Lord of Winterfell honours us with precise, measured, wholly unreadable northern courtesy.

We came north side by side — dragons above the retinue's long column, the Free Cities' envoys sent home to mend their own nets — and if the crowds of the winter town cheered the spectacle, the hall of Winterfell reserves judgement. The North does not warm to visitors for arriving impressively.

Alysanne squeezes my arm as the doors boom shut behind us. 'Patience, my love. Ice melts. I have done this before.'
russian: Винтерфелл принимает нас обоих с точной, нечитаемой учтивостью. Север не согревается за впечатляющее прибытие. Алисанна сжимает мою руку: «Терпение, любовь моя. Лёд тает».

english:
Lord Stark receives me in the yard of Winterfell with every honour the law requires and the particular guarded stillness the North keeps for dragons.

Alysanne's half-year of warmth has gone before me and made the way smoother than it might have been: the hall is correct, the feast is laid, the words are all the proper words. But the eyes that watch me down the length of that smoky hall belong to lords whose fathers knelt to mine under threat of fire, and none of them have forgotten it.

Winterfell will be won the way Alysanne won it, or not at all: slowly.
russian: Лорд Старк принимает меня со всеми почестями и сдержанной неподвижностью Севера для драконов. Полгода тепла Алисанны сделали путь глаже, но глаза лордов помнят, чьи отцы преклоняли колени под угрозой огня.\n\nВинтерфелл будет завоёван так, как Алисанна завоевала его, или никак.

english:
We go down with torches, past the stone kings in their rows — the Kings of Winter with their swords across their knees and their direwolves at their feet, ten thousand years of them staring blind into the dark. Lord Alaric says nothing the whole descent.

He stops at a tomb newer than the rest, the stone still pale. The likeness is of a big man with a blade across his knees, and I do not need the name read to me.

'My brother Walton,' Alaric says. 'He took Ice north against the men Your Grace sent to the Wall, and beheaded the first of them with it. The others he chased beyond the Wall, into the haunted forest. The giants tore him into five pieces. We buried what came back.' He raises the torch, and his eyes come to mine at last. 'You spared those knights, Your Grace. I have wondered these eight years what it is a king says to that.'
russian: Мы спускаемся с факелами мимо каменных королей. Лорд Аларик молчит. Он останавливается у свежей могилы. Изваяние изображает большого человека с клинком на коленях.\n\n«Мой брат Уолтон. Он взял Лёд на север против людей, которых вы пощадили. Великаны разорвали его на пять частей. Вы пощадили тех рыцарей. Я размышлял эти восемь лет, что король говорит на это».

english: There is no tomb to visit, and no grudge kept above one. Instead there is a feast — and at the high table, a Lord of Winterfell telling his bannermen, once more and by popular demand, the tale of the winter the King came north.\n\n'Rimegate was to be MY grave, like as not,' Walton Stark says, with the grim satisfaction the North reserves for its narrowest escapes. 'Storming a Wall castle in a mutiny winter — ask the Watch what that costs. And then the sky rattled, and the mutineers' gate opened, and the whole cursed business was done before my column cleared the Gift.' He raises his cup to me, and the hall comes up with him. 'To the debt the King paid HIMSELF, sers. The North remembers good as well as ill.'
russian: Нет могилы, только пир — и Лорд Винтерфелла, рассказывающий историю о зиме, когда Король пришёл на север. «Римгейт должен был стать МОЕЙ могилой. А затем небо задрожало, ворота открылись, и дело кончилось». Он поднимает чашу за меня.\n\n«За долг, который Король заплатил САМ. Север помнит и добро, и зло».

english:
There is no tomb to visit and no grudge in this hall — only a feast, and a Lord of Winterfell who unbends over the course of it from granite to mere oak.

It is late, and the fires low, when Walton Stark speaks of it at last. 'My father used to say your justice bought this peace, Your Grace. Maegor's knights, the ones you gave the sword.' He turns his cup slowly. 'Men called it harsh in the south, I am told. No northman called it so. Oathbreakers sent to the Wall are oathbreakers still — the Watch has buried brothers for lesser mercies. You spent six heads to spare it that. Winterfell counts the bargain cheap.'
